title: Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Desk Card — Cancellation Charge Rate and the Ship-By Date in Force
content:
**Rule.** The charge rate for cancelling a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Deposit Pre-Order at will follows how close the cancellation comes to the ship-by date in force. The distance is counted in calendar days from today to that date.

| Calendar days from today to the ship-by date in force | Charge rate |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 15 | 15 percent |
| More than 60 | 5 percent |
| 15 to 60, both included | Not changed by proximity |

The ship-by date in force is the current ship-by date on the reservation record, after any accepted revision. The charge rate enters the one product that makes up the cancellation charge. The cap at the deposit held and the rounding to the cent apply after it, to the whole product.

**Edges**

| Days to the ship-by date | Charge rate |
|---|---|
| 14 | 15 percent |
| 15 | Not changed by proximity |
| 60 | Not changed by proximity |
| 61 | 5 percent |

**Desk notes**

- A current ship-by date that has already passed is fewer than 15 days away, so the rate is 15 percent.
- The distance is measured to the current ship-by date, not to the original one. For example, a reservation whose original ship-by date was 10 days away but whose current ship-by date is 70 days away is charged at 5 percent.
